hello! this is my first post since i joined nearly two years ago, i'm stepping out from my comfort zone for the sake of helping *f2p & new players* (and because i haven't seen another guide posted for the current or updated dzone yet)


**here's my casual-focused slideshow that features:** 

✦ an **arachne build** that can entirely solo wave 5 normal and many of the other waves on hard, that's fool-proof and *prioritizes survival* (at low/mid investment or using support), with a summary

✦ general introduction to **dzone rewards, update state** and why the focus on wave 5. followed by a handful of hints for tackling hard or higher difficulties yourself and the differences between normal vs hard (mentions hp% attacks, astral reign reminders and further reading)

✦ wave 5 **"soul reaper" boss fight** breakdown, based on normal mode. the *most important buffs* have been summarized and given context, attack phases, extra hints, a bug warning and a critical info summary

✦ dzone **score rewards between 250-390** with combinations from normal, hard and extra clears that are required for rewards, *nightmare is excluded*

✦ **realm reminders**, focusing only on the survival mechanics that help with dzone, along with divine realm names and associated character icons

✦ additional build notes for arachne; both serving as an explanation behind the thought process and perspective as a casual player  

✦ extra notes and cut *work in progress info*, that i didn't have the time or energy to include 

-# *note that i cleared hard wave 5 myself without using ecog/revive but relied on vortice support and death res… so i'm only focusing on normal mode as that's the trending topic and main concern for f2p & new players to clear, in the current state*

slides will be posted *2-4 images at a time* for formatting and file size limits, you may view the **canva link here**: https://canva.link/wbecpq3gsxuz14n

content:
**current state of the dzone:**
while the plans to nerf dzone *next rotation are confirmed*, this still leave one more week for players to face the current state and selection of bosses! so i tried to make it vague enough where the info for "soul reaper" continues as a reminder for attack patterns and buffs, while this "slow but steady" arachne solo carry build should stay relevant for future ultra weeks.

while i acknowledge the *valid concerns* for the recent difficulty spike and high hp scaling in higher dzone difficulties, as discussed in **"D-tide Feedback (New)"**, that's part of a larger problem and a different topic. my only focus here is for a *easy normal wave 5 clear*, which can also work on the hard stages too, until the dzone updates are live for next week. 

**another casual disclaimer:**
please remember *i'm not an expert*, there's way more impressive dzone players!! however i'm committed to playing with many *self-imposed disadvantages* and "rules" (no limited overexalts, no rewinds, etc) to attest for morimens being very f2p and casual friendly! so while i'm not the person to show how to break records and clear nightmare/madness with *perfectly optimized teams*, i want to offer some tips and guidance specifically for players who can't clear normal wave 5 or found it too frustrating, while offering a low stakes clear that priorities *your survival*.
thread_title: D-Zone Casual Tips for Wave 5 Normal & Arachne Carry (V2.6 UGC)

content:
**final words:**
if you do know another *low investment character* that can solo-carry f2p/new players through a hard wave 5: that's awesome!!! please make a guide and start another thread, player moral is low and NEEDS the *encouragement and support* right now!

unfortunately **i do not have the energy nor social battery to collab with strangers or update on request**; this is intended as a beginner's "starting point" rather than an endgame "the ultimate wave 5 guide" i'm only aiming to ease tension and bring hope (or at least laughs?)

AND FINALLY: ***best of luck and may the silver key guide us.***
